unhandledError.text: `{{callee}}` returns an error and this call drops it, so a failure here (a file that never closed, a write that never landed) passes unseen and the code runs on as if it succeeded. Handle the error, or return it to a caller that will. If dropping it is right, say why in a `// Ignored: <reason>` comment directly above the statement or at the end of its line, so the next reader knows the failure was weighed.

unhandledErrorWithoutReason.text: This call drops the error `{{callee}}` returns and says it is ignored without saying why. Name why the failure cannot matter after `Ignored:`, such as a cleanup whose failure changes nothing, because a marker with nothing after it tells the next reader nothing and excuses nothing.
